methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The IPCC reports index at https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/ lists all assessment cycles (AR7, AR6, AR5 ... AR1), the Synthesis Reports and Special Reports. The site is server-rendered WordPress HTML (not a SPA); plain GETs return real navigation links.

## Search
No public search API and no reliable search-URL template for report harvesting. Discovery is by browsing the reports index and following per-report landing pages.

## Filters
The index page offers on-page filtering by cycle in the browser, but no URL-parameter filter was verified. Cycle (ar6), working group (wg1/wg2/wg3/syr) and document type are encoded in the download URL path.

## Download
Two-hop navigation: the index links to landing pages like /report/sixth-assessment-report-working-group-i/, which link to a downloads page (/report/ar6/wg1/downloads/) that exposes direct PDFs. Confirmed direct-PDF examples: /report/ar6/syr/downloads/report/IPCC_AR6_SYR_FullVolume.pdf and /report/ar6/wg3/downloads/report/IPCC_AR6_WGIII_SummaryForPolicymakers.pdf. Filenames follow IPCC_AR6_{WG}_{Section}.pdf.

## Metadata & Enrichment
No DSpace/record API. Metadata (cycle, working group, section) is parsed from the URL path and PDF filename. Enrichment mode is none.

## Limitations
Server-rendered, so no headless browser is needed. However harvesting requires following report landing pages to their /downloads/ subpages rather than reading PDFs off a single flat index; a crawler must walk that two/three-hop structure.
probeNotes: WebFetch of https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/ confirmed server-rendered HTML listing AR7/AR6/AR5... with landing-page links (e.g. /report/sixth-assessment-report-working-group-i/) but no direct PDFs on the index. WebSearch confirmed the /report/ar6/{wg}/downloads/report/*.pdf direct-PDF pattern. No API.
